engp.title: English proficiency | METU International Students Office
quotes: The medium of instruction at METU is English. However, for undergraduate programs, submitting an English proficiency score is not obligatory for the application .
Those who do not satisfy the minimum score from this exam will attend English Preparatory Class at the Department of Basic English for one year.
IELTS exams taken on or after the 24th of December 2022 will not be anymore accepted.

program.name: Aerospace Engineering
program.summary: Aerospace Engineering (B.S.), 4 years, METU Ankara campus; taught in English (one-year English preparatory class if needed).

terms_evidence: the Spring Semester of the 2026 - 2027 Academic Year
costs.note: 2026-2027: USD 1200 per semester (Fall and Spring), paid in Turkish lira at the Central Bank rate; yearly figure is our calculation. Living costs aren't added: METU publishes them in Turkish lira only.

admissions.threshold: Aerospace Engineering: IB Diploma with at least 33 points, including at least one Higher Level course relevant to the programme. These are METU's minimum application requirements (list last updated 05/01/2024); meeting them doesn't guarantee admission, which is decided within the international student quota.

english.min_score: Not needed to apply. METU teaches in English; without a valid TOEFL or PTE Academic score at registration you take METU's English Proficiency Exam, or a one-year English preparatory class.
english.notes: METU no longer accepts IELTS taken on or after 24 December 2022.
